title: Right-size queue snapshot launch freshness
summary: Treat Queue snapshot timestamp age as advisory while preserving deterministic scan correlation, accepted-plan integrity, and the runtime queue rebuild/fingerprint stop.
reason: Run Once rebuilds the backend-owned queue before media dispatch, so rejecting an otherwise valid accepted plan solely because its preview timestamp, file mtime, clock, or timezone evidence is old or imperfect adds operator friction without reducing media risk. Scope, provenance, input, membership, pending-safety, naming, and fingerprint checks remain authoritative.
behavior_before: Blank Run Once and several read-only Queue surfaces could block or warn solely because queue snapshot produced_at, file mtime, clock-skew, or timestamp-format evidence was outside a freshness window, even though runtime rebuilds the queue before dispatch.
behavior_after: Queue timestamp evidence remains parsed and exposed for cache/display context but never blocks normal Run Once. Primary Launch, Queue, Home, and cross-page status surfaces label age as advisory; the backend Queue preview may still flag old display evidence for review, but that posture is read-only and non-authoritative for launch. Missing or unreadable plans, incomplete scans, scope/origin/request/input mismatches, pending-safety failures, invalid accepted membership/naming/fingerprints, and validated zero-work plans still block. Start revalidates under the durable lease, and the engine rebuilds the queue and rejects an active plan-fingerprint change before media dispatch.
manual_validation: Bundled PowerShell Invoke-PipelineQueueEngineChecks.ps1 passed, including the active plan-fingerprint mismatch stop before dispatch.
Bundled Python broader queue launch, API contract, config, and WebView static regression run passed: 171 tests.
Bundled Python focused queue launch/preview policy run passed: 3 tests.
Bundled Python py_compile passed for all changed Python files; Node --check passed for all changed Queue WebView JavaScript files.
WebView browser Launch/Queue readiness smoke passed: 2 tests, 0 skipped, with no POST routes or media mutation.
rollback_plan: Restore launch-time freshness rejection and age-only Queue warning copy together while retaining the durable launch lease, accepted-plan integrity checks, and PowerShell active-plan fingerprint guard.
notes:
High-risk boundary: standard backend Queue Run Once launch only. CSV rerun and Network coordinator workflows remain separate and are not enrolled in this snapshot contract. Validation uses temporary roots and synthetic media metadata; no source media mutation or real-media processing is required because FFmpeg, stream, subtitle, audio, publish, and source-movement policy are unchanged.
